Breakfast Egg Burrito
By: Chef Sowmya
Published: Sunday, September 1, 2013 - 5:08pm

Ingredients




3 eggs
1 green pepper chopped
1/2 a tomato chopped
1 chive chopped
1 slice of swiss cheese
Salt and pepper
1 tablespoon Blood Orange Olive oil
2 flour tortillas
Honey Chipotle BBQ sauce (optional)

Preparation

1 In a fry pan, heat up the oil and fry the veggies for a few minutes 2 Then add the eggs and mix it up, so it scrambles; cook till the water is gone; add the cheese pieces and mix up the meal well, so all the ingredients are blended in 3 Add salt and pepper; heat up the burrito 4 Add the eggs over the burrito and I like to add some tangy and yummy honey chipotle BBQ sauce.

About

Delicious eggs in veggies wrapped in a tortilla.
